notes.title: SWAT Commander v.0.7.7.5 – Game Mode Update!
notes.content: [p]🚨 Officers,[/p][p][/p][p]We're deploying an update for SWAT Commander to [b]version 0.7.7.5![/b][/p][p]This time, we introduce our first additions of [i]Advanced[/i] game modes to the missions — "Random Range" and "Tank on Tank"![/p][p][/p][p]Remember that for the next week, [b]SWAT Commander is available at a 20% discount![/b] This is a great moment to grab our game if you haven't yet because we're not done with our updates. [b]New mission coming September 29th, so don't miss out![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]What are game modes?[/b] Well, let's do a [b]quick recap[/b] — game modes are basically different configurations that you can apply to your mission's playthrough while setting it up. The ones we've had so far for every mission (which [b]we'll refer to from now on as the [i]Classic[/i] game modes[/b]) came in three options. Game modes alter many properties of a mission, including its objectives, environment details, the behavior and equipment used by the suspects you encounter, and even some core mechanics. So let's talk about the [b]new ones![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/c25ad4a2d7bcdaee23df471cd43eaed3660ce14f.png"][/img][i]You can find the Advanced Game Modes tab here after selecting the mission you want to play[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Random Range[/b] — Your intel was bad, Commander. As in, "the investigation team is to report to the chief of police immediately" level of bad. [b]Nothing matches, nothing makes sense, and worse yet — you have scracely little hope of knowing what's in store![/b] Terrorist bombers on a farm? No one saw that coming. Why are there gangers teaming up with hillbillies and where is your backup? All good questions, such a shame there's no time for answers. It's just you and your adaptation skills stretched to their limits.[/p][p][b]Tank on Tank[/b] — Well, well, look who's bringing out the big guns! Unfortunately, it's the suspects. Yep, [b]they're packing some serious heat with advanced weapons, heavy armor, and top-of-the-line shields.[/b] Ouch. You know how they say fight fire with fire, so you'd better follow suit if you're to stand any chance of bringing in these tanky perps. Only the biggest bullet sponges will survive this intense encounter.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/a4fd18172f1faf45fe2363873fe24ca6bfb5d85c.png"][/img][i]Remember that you can find the Headcam view that lets you observe the game from the SWAT officer's helmet-mounted camera in the gameplay settings[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]SWAT Commander v.0.7.7.5 - Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]GAME FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Advanced Game Mode for each mission — Random Range[/p][/*][*][p]New Advanced Game Mode for each mission — Tank on Tank[/p][/*][/list][p][b]EQUIPMENT[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added randomization of attachments when using the randomize current equipment button on the equipment screen [/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the player names setting in the pause menu not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with input settings not initializing correctly on clients[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check out the [b]Tank on Tank game mode in action[/b] while using the [b]headcam view feature[/b] during the Breaking Point mission:[/p][previewyoutube="ajKK5dnQzV8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]After the [b]next, new mission update[/b], it'll be time for [b]a roadmap[/b] with more of our update plans laid out for you to investigate![/p][p][/p][p]Over and out,[/p][p]SWAT Commander Team[/p]

notes.title: Prologue Patch/Development Updates – 06
notes.content:
[p]Officers, 👮‍♂️[/p][p]We’re rolling out [b]a big update for SWAT Commander: Prologue[/b]! Check out our patch notes for details on all the improvements: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2428730/announcements/detail/545611272206420614"][/dynamiclink]We've got more features and changes coming to our Early Access version and once again, we'd like to discuss a select few along with a short video presentation. Many of these focus particularly with the convenience of gameplay in mind.[/p][previewyoutube="cJUb2Hi0p5U;full"][/previewyoutube][list][*][p][b]The Evidence Hint system[/b]: A new feature introduced in an effort to make the Evidence collection aspect of the game more manageable. This should prove helpful, for example, in case you get stuck on finding a particularly difficult to spot piece of evidence or elusive suspect.[/p][p]A voiced report from TOC informs you about the location of this objective and a prompt on screen directs you towards it. [b]We're currently considering scaling this feature across difficulty levels.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Filter for door-related commands:[/b] From now, the commands you can issue to your SWAT officers that are related to doors and doorways are dependent on both on the state of that given door together with the equipment available to your squad. [/p][p]In order to know how you can proceed with the door, you need to investigate it with your Officers stacking up on it and if it turns out to be locked, you can proceed with lockpicking or breaching commands.[/p][p]This serves to both add more realism to the game and clean up the Command List considerably.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The "Search and Secure" Command[/b]: A new command joins the SWAT arsenal! With Search and Secure, you can have your team or your entire squad perform a search of a cleared room for Suspects, Civilians, or Evidence to secure. [/p][p]The AI system selects appropriate targets in an organized way and completes these objectives for you. Just make sure to be on alert as severe vulnerability is the cost of this procedure![/p][/*][/list][p]We have more to report, so stick with us for further [b]summaries of other fixes and improvements[/b] making their way to the upcoming EA release. [/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to check out our [b]free co-op prologue[/b] if you haven't tried the game yet!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428730/SWAT_Commander_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink]Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team[/p]

tags.feature: The Evidence Hint system: A new feature introduced in an effort to make the Evidence collection aspect of the game more manageable.

Filter for door-related commands: From now, the commands you can issue to your SWAT officers that are related to doors and doorways are dependent on both on the state of that given door together with the equipment available to your squad.
The "Search and Secure" Command: A new command joins the SWAT arsenal!

notes.title: Development Updates – 05
notes.content:
Officers, 👮‍♂️

Our today's report discusses [b]the latest improvements added to the upcoming Early Access version of the game[/b] since the prologue's release. There's plenty to choose from, and we'll cover more in our next devlogs, but for now have our first picks: 

[list][*][b]Character responses to gunshots[/b]: For improved realism, the game's characters will now have a broader range of responses to weapons being discharged or similar response-inducing situations, such as restrained suspects flinching if there's someone firing a gun nearby.
[*][b]Improved AI following[/b]: Targeting, positioning, providing cover. There are lots of factors a SWAT squad has to take into account when following their leader if they're to be safe and effective. We're working to optimize the various behaviors connected with these actions to make them as helpful to you as possible in single player.
[*][b]Equipment presets[/b]: Figured out a few gear setups you'd like to use when fulfilling different roles in the squad? Want to save them and freely change them when playing the missions either in single player or co-op? You'll be able to do just that with the preset feature. Our future updates will include default presets that can perform well in various situations.
[*][b]Character selection for co-op[/b]: Step into the shoes of your chosen officer in a multiplayer session of SWAT Commander. You'll be able to play the role of any of our brave officers![/list]
[previewyoutube=IBYvaZZMDow;full][/previewyoutube]
We're hard at work testing, fixing, and further improving the game with such features! We thank you for the feedback you've been providing. Give our prologue a shot if you haven't yet and stick with us for the upcoming Early Access release! 📣

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: Development Updates – 04
notes.content:
Officers, 👮‍♂️

The suspects in [b]SWAT Commander[/b] are dangerous! We’ve made significant upgrades to their combat capabilities, ensuring they pose a realistic challenge during missions.

[h3]Suspect Combat Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Better Aiming:[/b] Suspects are more realistically accurate and responsive with their weapons, maintaining the intensity of encounters but making them manageable.
[*][b]Smart Grenade Usage:[/b] Expect suspects to deploy grenades, keeping your team on their toes.
[*][b]Enhanced Noise Detection:[/b] Suspects will detect gunfire more precisely, even differentiating between suppressed and unsuppressed weapons.
[/list]
These changes add a new layer of [b]realism and challenge[/b] to every operation. Adapt your tactics and stay vigilant—your foes are learning! 👮

[previewyoutube=FJlU9CAsPqc;full][/previewyoutube]

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

- Smart Grenade Usage: Expect suspects to deploy grenades, keeping your team on their toes.
- Enhanced Noise Detection: Suspects will detect gunfire more precisely, even differentiating between suppressed and unsuppressed weapons.

notes.title: Development Updates – 03
notes.content:
Officers, 👮‍♂️

In this update we describe our change to how civilians will react more dynamically to the chaos of a mission, making protection and restraint an even bigger challenge.

[h3]Civilian Behavior[/h3]

Here’s what’s in the improvement:
[list]
[*][b]Hiding:[/b] During a shootout, civilians will instinctively look for places to hide, adding realism and tension.
[*][b]Increased Mobility:[/b] Civilians will now move around the map more frequently, creating unpredictable scenarios for your team.
[*][b]Fleeing Danger:[/b] When danger is near, civilians are more likely to run from it, making quick reactions crucial to ensure their safety.
[/list]
This change adds complexity to your missions – keeping civilians safe while managing suspects just got a whole lot harder. We can’t wait to see how you adapt to these situations! 🙋

[previewyoutube=Ks4KMJeh710;full][/previewyoutube]

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: Development Updates – 02
notes.content:
Officers, 👮‍♂️

Here's something we added for the sake of both our new and returning players and the experience it's meant to improve for you through visual enhancements.
There are a few such changes we're introducing, so we'll write more about them in future posts as they become ready.

[h3]Weather and time-of-day variants[/h3]

The various missions of SWAT Commander will be available in randomly selected variants for weather and time-of-day combinations. However, our system will track your previous configuration, so it doesn't repeat throughout mission playthroughs.

This opens possibilities of replaying your favorite mission under an entirely different mood or setting. Silence of the Hansons in broad daylight? Hot Reception with a roaring thunderstorm outside? All a possibility. ⛈️

What’s more, these conditions affect the behavior of characters, adding another tactical layer to the game. For example, manipulating the fuse box at night can give you an advantage by making it harder for Suspects to aim but instantly making them alert. Mind the mission briefing, however. Some Suspects may come equipped for such circumstances! 🔦

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/ac07763c8cd21ae99d9d70e7dcd4cc1a7efd48d0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/6fe1876129f04c6f06da9e914ba9076c8f5f9ec6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/dc335be112fd4bf54b5e30a0afd1147354a38b91.gif[/img]

Next post – More gameplay-related updates.

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: Development Updates – 01
notes.content:
Officers, 👮‍♂️

2025 is the year of SWAT Commander – it's when we'll finally be ready to launch early access. Stay tuned for announcements about relevant dates concerning [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428730/SWAT_Commander_Prologue/]the free prologue[/url] and the game itself.

In the time leading up to these releases, we want to start posting some more regular development updates here on Steam. We've gone through a few playtests, gathered a lot of feedback, and realizing there's a lot we still needed to do to bring you the best game that we could, introduced lots of different changes and enhancements to SWAT Commander, both visually and gameplay-wise. ⭐

[h3]Automatic area cover[/h3]

SWAT Commander can only benefit from improvements to the officer's AI, so this feature has been one of many aspects we're focusing on. With the officers being more responsive and effective in single-player, it'll obviously be a better experience with the game. 

One way we can accomplish this is by having them relocate properly after combat, in accordance with police protocol. Now your squad takes advantageous positions in the room when they're done engaging hostiles. Ones that offer the most protection in case weapons go hot again. 👁️

[previewyoutube=OHWhvTOiMzM;full][/previewyoutube]

More updates to come!

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

tags.feature: Now your squad takes advantageous positions in the room when they're done engaging hostiles.

notes.title: FPS Fest | Demo!

Officers,

Long time no report, but we've got something for you now that's bound to catch your attention.

Tactical Squad: SWAT Stories is taking part in [b]Steam's FPS Fest event[/b], taking place from April 15-22! The event starts at 10:00 AM Pacific Time (19:00 CEST) and hosts a broad range of everything that's [b]first-person shooter[/b]!

notes.title: Development Briefing – 9 | Updates and Second Playtest!
notes.content:
Officers,

As we work on numerous aspects of SWAT Stories, its prologue version, "First Shot" receives [b]several fixes and improvements[/b]. But we know there's a piece of news you've been waiting for even more eagerly. So, we're happy to confirm that [b]our game's playtest returns tomorrow on Friday, November 24th at 3pm CET (9am EST) WITH A BRAND NEW MISSION – "HOT RECEPTION"[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428730/Tactical_Squad_SWAT_Stories__First_Shot/

[b]Only when the playtest is live[/b], will you be able to sign up (you won't need to sign up if you took part in the first playtest) and download/update the game.

[/list]

TUTORIAL
[list]

[/list]
VISUAL
[list]
[*] Added glass damage effects on cars
[*] Added environmental response to weather changes

[*] Fixed a number of miscellaneous visual glitches
[/list]
Add our game to your wishlist to support our project and [url=https://discord.gg/DQepwC6CcN]join our Discord server[/url] to take part in the discussion of Tactical Squad and its features!

Over and out,
Red Mountain Games & Ritual Interactive

notes.title: Development Briefing – 7 | Free Co-op Prologue!
notes.content:
Officers,

Long time no report. But we have something good to report once again! We're currently planning the release of a [b]free prologue[/b] for Tactical Squad: SWAT Stories! We're calling it '[b]First Shot[/b]'.

[b]↓ Check it out right here! ↓[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428730/Tactical_Squad_SWAT_Stories__First_Shot/

We're using [b]Steam's public playtest[/b] feature to let you know when the prologue is available. You can [b]sign up for it[/b] right now and later be notified. This way we'll know if there's anything urgent to tweak before we make First Shot available for good.
